description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Periyasamy Sivasamy Pathmanadan as Vice Chairman of the Nuwara Eliya P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman in a local government body (Nuwara-Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for a specific local authority position, including the reason for the vacancy, the procedure for nomination by a political party, and the official declaration of the elected individual. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters for local authorities.
